# MODULUX — Double-Wing Folding Homes, Cape Town, South Africa

> MODULUX builds precision-engineered, NHBRC-registered double-wing folding homes in Cape Town and delivers nationwide across South Africa. From R35,000. Display Village in Bellville, Western Cape.

## Frequently asked questions

**How long does delivery take?** Most MODULUX homes are completed in 60–90 days from order confirmation.

**Starting price?** R35,000 for the 10ft Double-Wing Folding Home.

**Nationwide delivery?** Yes — all nine South African provinces.

**NHBRC registered?** Yes — all MODULUX homes are NHBRC registered.
